result.title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在 Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5、Gemma-3 上沿视觉 token 到答案字母逐层追踪跨图像匹配失败，指出两处断点——比较已发生但未被读出、语义对应未进入答案——并定位到 16-32 个承载比较的注意力头，仅训练其 query/key 投影（约 0.02% 参数）即显著修复 SPair-71k、HPatches 与 BLINK 表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「视觉证据是否保留在内部状态、答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」这一线索：探针可解码却超不过校准输出、剖面重分配注意力即抹去 17-32 点精度，可供核查 LVR 中「信息存在但未参与读出」的伪贡献与注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响，其低参数 QK 修复思路也可能与训练监督设计相关。
